sections.heading: How to Play Frost
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="How to Play Frost"][color=c8]Frost Mage Rotation in Midnight Season 1[/color][/h2]
Frost Mage is a relatively straightforward specialization in Midnight. While there are nuances to learn, the rotation is mainly based on consuming stacks of a debuff on your targets, keeping cooldowns running, and reacting to some random procs.

[wrapper width=1100px][box border=true]
[center][table style=grid]
[tr][td]
[table]
  [tr]
  [td width=6%][icon name=inv12_ability_mage_freezing size=medium type=round color=c8 inline=true][/icon][/td]
  [td][b][color=c8]Utilize Shatter:[/color][/b] Avoid wasting stacks of the [spell=1221389] debuff. You can consume them and trigger [spell=1246769] with some spells like [spell=30455] and [spell=1247777].
  [/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
  [tr]
  [td width=6%][icon name=ability_mage_rayoffrost size=medium type=round color=c8 inline=true][/icon][/td]
  [td][b][color=c8]Utilize your Major Cooldowns:[/color][/b] [spell=205021] and [spell=84714] deal a lot of damage and should be used often.
  [/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
  [tr]
  [td width=6%][icon name=ability_mage_glacialspike size=medium type=round color=c8 inline=true][/icon][/td]
  [td][b][color=c8]Use Procs and Minor Cooldowns:[/color][/b] Spells like [spell=44614] and [spell=199786] are powerful and you'll want to use them often. In AoE, this also includes [spell=190356]. You will sometimes get procs like [spell=112965] or [spell=190447] that you'll typically want to spend quickly.[/td]
  [/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
  [tr]
  [td width=6%][icon name=spell_frost_frostbolt02 size=medium type=round color=c8 inline=true][/icon][/td]
  [td][b][color=c8]Always be Casting:[/color][/b] It's important to always be doing something. Even if the spells you are casting are suboptimal, doing so is significantly better than casting nothing while trying to decide what to do. [spell=116]/[spell=431044] is the main filler spell here for Frost Mage and [spell=30455] can be used while moving.[/td]
  [/tr]
[/table]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[/center]
[/box][/wrapper]
[pad]
[center][cta-button guide=33125 icon=spell_frost_frostbolt02]Frost Mage Starter Guide[/cta-button][/center]

As every cast and GCD finishes, you can simply follow this list from top to bottom and press the button with the current highest value. sections.heading: Major Cooldowns
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Major Cooldowns" type=bar][color=c8][icon name=spell_frost_frostbolt02 type=round size=medium inline=true color=c8][/icon] Frost Mage Major Cooldowns[/color][/h2]
Frost's major cooldowns are quite a bit different with the rework in Midnight. [spell=205021] does a ton of damage and helps to speed up the rotation, but also leaves you quite vulnerable while you are using it.

[pad]
[tabs name="cds" uniform=true iconborders=true]

[tab name="Ray of Frost" icon=ability_mage_rayoffrost]
  [h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c8] Ray of Frost [/color][/h3]
  [spell=205021] is the major cooldown for Frost Mage. It deals a lot of damage and generates a lot of [spell=1221389] stacks. The most important thing to remember here is making sure that you can get the full channel off. Be ready to [spell=212653] to safety instead of canceling it and plan ahead if necessary to make sure you use it at a safe time.

  When playing [color=#a4c2f4]Frostfire[/color] with multiple targets, you can prioritize spending [spell=431176] first so that [spell=1247777] has more [spell=1221389] stacks to consume when you use it.
[/tab]

[tab name="Comet Storm" icon=spell_mage_cometstorm2]
  [h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c8] Comet Storm [/color][/h3]
  [spell=1247777] replaces [spell=205021] after you cast it. Keep in mind that in AoE situations this can [spell=1246769] stacks on multiple targets at once.
[/tab]

[tab name="Time Warp" icon=ability_mage_timewarp]
  [h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c8] Time Warp [/color][/h3]
  Use [spell=80353] before [spell=205021] or when your group needs it. This is an extremely powerful cooldown, but you can typically only use it once per boss fight and rarely in dungeons and the open world.
[/tab]

[/tabs]

sections.heading: Advanced Tips
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Advanced Tips" type=bar][color=c8][icon name=Inv_artifact_tome01 type=round size=medium inline=true color=c8][/icon] Frost Mage Advanced Tips[/color][/h2]
While the Frost rotation is relatively simple, it is important to keep in mind how the class interacts with encounters and take that into account to optimize your performance.
[pad]
[tabs name="advanced" uniform=true iconborders=true]
[tab name="Charged Cooldowns" icon=spell_frost_chillingarmor]
  [h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c8] Charged Cooldowns [/color][/h3]
  Frost Mage has a big advantage over the other Mage specializations in Midnight, which is the charged cooldowns gained by [spell=1263249] and [spell=1244110].
  [ul]
  [li]With [spell=1263249] at level 90, [spell=205021] will have 2 charges, which provides significant flexibility in when you do deal damage. Keep it on cooldown, but as long as you have less than two charges you have a lot of choice in when you use the other charge. In particular, this has the potential to be very strong when bosses have vulnerability phases or spawn priority adds that must be killed.[/li]
  [li][spell=1244110] grants two charges of both [spell=11426] and [spell=45438]/[spell=414659]. This makes it much easier to ensure that you have defensive cooldowns available for big damage events and offers a huge optimization opportunity if you're interesting in carefully scripting out all of your defensive usages in a boss fight.[/li]
  [/ul]
[/tab]
[/tabs]
[pad]

Our Frost Mage guides are always updated with the latest information from in-game experience, simulations, and logs. Make sure to check our changelog for this page by clicking on [b]View Changelog[/b] in the Quick Facts column or on the book icon at the top of the page. If you are interested in more in-depth Frost Mage guides for [b]Midnight Season 1[/b], make sure to browse the [i]Navigation Bar[/i] at the top of the page, along with our list of [b]Related Guides[/b] just beneath the [i]Table of Contents[/i].



[tooltip name=NotesHighlight][color=q]Notes will appear here.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=THERMAL_VOID_TIP][color=q]Because Thermal Void is very impactful, you should use it before getting a new one from using Brain Freeze.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=FOF_CLEAVE_TIP][color=q]This is minor against one target, but it is significant when cleaving an extra target to prioritize this and avoid wasting Fingers of Frost.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=RAY_OF_FROST_TIP][color=q]Be sure you are using Ray of Frost early in your opener. Also use it at high priority at the end of the fight or during important burst moments if it's available.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=BLIZZARD_FROZEN_ORB_TIP][color=q]You can elect not to use Blizzard here if its cooldown won't be ready before Frozen Orb's cooldown finishes. This allows you to use it with Freezing Rain immediately after Frozen Orb.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=GS_OPENER_TIP][color=q]If you have 5 Icicles, opening with Glacial Spike is ideal, but due to the 12.0.5 changes you can't always do this, especially because pulling a raid boss will reset your Icicles.[/color][/tooltip]

Frost's major cooldowns are quite a bit different with the rework in Midnight. [spell=205021] does a ton of damage and helps to speed up the rotation, but also leaves you quite vulnerable while you are using it.

[pad]
[tabs name="cds" uniform=true iconborders=true]

[tab name="Ray of Frost" icon=ability_mage_rayoffrost]
  [h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c8] Ray of Frost [/color][/h3]
  [spell=205021] is the major cooldown for Frost Mage. It deals a lot of damage and generates a lot of [spell=1221389] stacks. The most important thing to remember here is making sure that you can get the full channel off. Be ready to [spell=212653] to safety instead of canceling it and plan ahead if necessary to make sure you use it at a safe time.

  When playing [color=#a4c2f4]Frostfire[/color] with multiple targets, you can prioritize spending [spell=431176] first so that [spell=1247777] has more [spell=1221389] stacks to consume when you use it.
[/tab]

[tab name="Comet Storm" icon=spell_mage_cometstorm2]
  [h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c8] Comet Storm [/color][/h3]
  [spell=1247777] replaces [spell=205021] after you cast it. Keep in mind that in AoE situations this can [spell=1246769] stacks on multiple targets at once.

[tab name="Time Warp" icon=ability_mage_timewarp]

[h2 toc="Advanced Tips" type=bar][color=c8][icon name=Inv_artifact_tome01 type=round size=medium inline=true color=c8][/icon] Frost Mage Advanced Tips[/color][/h2]

[tab name="Charged Cooldowns" icon=spell_frost_chillingarmor]
  [h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c8] Charged Cooldowns [/color][/h3]
  Frost Mage has a big advantage over the other Mage specializations in Midnight, which is the charged cooldowns gained by [spell=1263249] and [spell=1244110].
  [ul]
  [li]With [spell=1263249] at level 90, [spell=205021] will have 2 charges, which provides significant flexibility in when you do deal damage. Keep it on cooldown, but as long as you have less than two charges you have a lot of choice in when you use the other charge. In particular, this has the potential to be very strong when bosses have vulnerability phases or spawn priority adds that must be killed.[/li]
  [li][spell=1244110] grants two charges of both [spell=11426] and [spell=45438]/[spell=414659]. This makes it much easier to ensure that you have defensive cooldowns available for big damage events and offers a huge optimization opportunity if you're interesting in carefully scripting out all of your defensive usages in a boss fight.[/li]
  [/ul]

[tooltip name=THERMAL_VOID_TIP][color=q]Because Thermal Void is very impactful, you should use it before getting a new one from using Brain Freeze.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=FOF_CLEAVE_TIP][color=q]This is minor against one target, but it is significant when cleaving an extra target to prioritize this and avoid wasting Fingers of Frost.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=RAY_OF_FROST_TIP][color=q]Be sure you are using Ray of Frost early in your opener. Also use it at high priority at the end of the fight or during important burst moments if it's available.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=BLIZZARD_FROZEN_ORB_TIP][color=q]You can elect not to use Blizzard here if its cooldown won't be ready before Frozen Orb's cooldown finishes. This allows you to use it with Freezing Rain immediately after Frozen Orb.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=GS_OPENER_TIP][color=q]If you have 5 Icicles, opening with Glacial Spike is ideal, but due to the 12.0.5 changes you can't always do this, especially because pulling a raid boss will reset your Icicles.[/color][/tooltip]
